The item to show now

Source: R/fct_cat.R
cat_item.Rd

The item to show now

Usage

cat_item(s)

Arguments

s

A CAT session.

Value

A list with the scale, the stem (NA when the bank has none), the question, the answer options, the key (the correct option of a dichotomous item, or NA), whether its text is public and the model of the current item, or NULL when the test is done.

See also

Other CAT session: cat_answer(), cat_results(), cat_start(), plot_cat_trajectory()

Examples

q <- read_questionnaire(example_questionnaires()[5]) # SAT12, 3PL
cat_item(cat_start(q))
#> $scale
#> [1] "Science (SAT12)"
#> 
#> $stem
#> [1] "The texts of the SAT12 questions are not public: choose one of the five options."
#> 
#> $question
#> [1] "SAT12 science question 2"
#> 
#> $options
#> [1] "Option A" "Option B" "Option C" "Option D" "Option E"
#> 
#> $key
#> [1] 4
#> 
#> $public
#> [1] FALSE
#> 
#> $model
#> [1] "dichotomous"
#>
